detail: raw exception normalised to UNEXPECTED_ERROR: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toUpperCase')
note: uom/Iso4217.ts's isIso4217 does code.toUpperCase() with no guard, and its callers reach it with undefined. From the ./vm surface that is a string-table index out of range. From ORDINARY SOURCE it is the OperandWidth desync (see the expression-throw entry), and in that path it runs inside preflight, outside executeBytecode()'s try/catch, so the raw TypeError escapes evaluateExpression() to the host. FIXED: the PUSH_NUMBER/PUSH_STRING constant-pool operands are bounds-checked in vm/VM.ts, so an empty pool is refused with MALFORMED_BYTECODE_CONSTANT_INDEX before an undefined currency code can reach isIso4217. The ordinary-source path into the same isIso4217 call was the OperandWidth DATE_LITERAL desync, fixed separately (see expression-throw-07ce250e).
